title: Dune Allen "Magical Place" 21 Magical Place
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Community pool- 6-passenger low speed vehicle- Propane grill- Foosball table- 3 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Bask in the beauty of a Dune Allen getaway at Magical Place, a beautiful 2-story, 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home, sleeping up to 9 guests, and nestled 50 feet from the community pool! Beach access is only a 7-minute walk away, alongside Stinky’s Fish Camp—a local favorite! Additional dining options and sweet treats are within a quick drive at Gulf Place Town Center for ultimate convenience.A coastal blue exterior and welcoming front porch greet guests at arrival—imagine starting each day enjoying the morning breeze with a rich cup of coffee. Head inside to find a spacious living area made for casual movie nights, with a soft couch, oversized round chair, and plush armchair surrounding a wall-mounted TV. Through a curved archway is the fully equipped kitchen with high-end appliances and a breakfast bar for 4 that overlooks the 6-person round table by the windows. Hungry for barbecue? The back deck boasts a propane grill and a 4-person patio table for dining alfresco. There’s also an outdoor shower for rinsing off sand and salt from the beach. When the day is done, retire to the primary bedroom with a private bathroom.The second floor features an additional living space for unwinding after a day in the sun. Gather around to watch TV, play a round of cards at the 4-person table, or revel in a bit of friendly competition at the foosball table. Out the side door, a furnished balcony offers a prime spot to relax with a drink. Sleeping accommodations on this floor include 1 guest bedroom with a queen bed and 1 bunk room with a twin-over-full bunk bed and twin trundle, plus a full sleeper sofa in the living space.Get away for a laid-back escape at Magical Place in Dune Allen. Exploring is easy with parking for 2 vehicles, 3 complimentary adult bikes, and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle. For beach access, take Charming Drive and Woodward Way to West County Highway 30A—Dune Allen Regional Beach Access will be across the road. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 9):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Full Bunk Bed with Twin Trundle Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Living Area: Family Room with Full Sleeper Sofa*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
